about: Known fuzz findings (plan W1.27) that are not fixed yet. Each one expires (at most 90 days out): after that date the finding fails the run again. Crashes are never listed here.

findings.what: 8–14 KB inputs with deep nesting (lists, block quotes, [[ runs, footnotes, directives) took 0.5–2.8 s in the remark/rehype chain, measured alone in the Vercel Sandbox (Node 24). Cause: thousands of [ / ] in one block (micromark's label ends look back through the open link starts) and lists 231 levels deep.
findings.next: Fixed by plan W4.16 (src/renderer/boundMarkdown.ts: a block over 256 brackets or 32 nesting levels is shown as raw text; the preview and this fuzz target both apply it). Delete this entry after `npm run fuzz` (1,000,000 inputs) shows no Markdown input over 200 ms.
